title: Black Holes as Almost-Perfect All:All Entanglement Graphs: Interior Collapse, Horizon Wiring, and the Micro-Hole Phase Transition
description: Computational companion to a toy theory in which black hole interiors are almost-perfect all:all entanglement graphs, horizon area counts exterior legs (A = 4ln2 k lp^2), and micro-holes undergo a point-to-horizon phase transition. v4.0 draft (resuscitate-no-neutrons): pulsars as low-k graphs, J0737 2PN at 0.00 sigma via p = 0.92, leg-shedding kilonovae with gap prediction. Includes reproducible simulations (Secs 1-3 + Appendices A-BS + BU), paper drafts (Markdown + LaTeX/PDF), figures, tests, and an interactive demo. Code MIT, text/figures CC BY 4.0.
